svg.text: Referenced roads (red) and railroads (blue), with measured positions
assets/roads.svg and assets/railroads.svg, the polylines the utility snaps to. North is up. East is right.
Window is the four positions plus 1.5 km: X 162805.08–166588.17 (north) Z 291619.37–295187.31 (east).
Left numbers are X (north). Bottom numbers are Z (east). Both are world metres.
Dots are the SVG vertices inside the window.
Dashed hairline: marker to the nearest point on that network.
Measured positions (world X north, Z east)
Distances are metres to the nearest drawn segment. # is the polyline index.
